in_greek.name: Τζολένη
in_greek.meaning: Θεός αναβαίνει και ενδυναμώνει το έθνος
in_greek.long_meaning: Τζολένη είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεός αναβαίνει και ενδυναμώνει το έθνος'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τα ονόματα Τζο και Λην, που σημαίνει 'Θεός ελεήσει' και 'φως' αντίστοιχα. Το όνομα Τζολένη χρησιμεύει ως σύμβολο της χριστιανικής πίστης και της ελπίδας στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Jolene
in_latin.long_meaning: Jolene est nomen christianum quod ex lingua anglica oritur et significat 'Deus eximius et fortis populi'. Nomen ex nominibus Jo et Lene derivatur, quae significant 'Deus misereatur' et 'lux' respective. Nomen Jolene est symbolum fidei christianae et spei in Deum.

in_english.name: Jolene
in_english.meaning: God will raise up and make strong the tribe
in_english.long_meaning: Jolene is a Christian name originating from English, meaning 'God will raise up and make strong the tribe'. The name is derived from the names Jo and Lene, which mean 'God will have mercy' and 'light' respectively. In Christian tradition, Jolene symbolizes faith and hope in God, reflecting a strong and divine presence. The name has been used across various Christian cultures, embodying spiritual significance and personality traits of strength and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jolene is of English origin and means "pretty violet." It gained significant cultural impact when country music legend Dolly Parton released her song "Jolene" in 1973. In the song, Parton begs a woman not to take her man away from her. The name Jolene became synonymous with beauty and has been a popular name for girls born in the decades following the song's release.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jolene holds spiritual significance in the sense that it is a reminder of the beauty of God's creation. The nickname "Jolene" means "pretty violet," reminding us of the lovely color and fragrance of the violet flower – a symbol of humility, devotion, and new beginnings in Christianity. Additionally, the name can inspire us to see the beauty and uniqueness in all people, fostering a greater appreciation and love for those around us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jolene, a name of French origin meaning "beautiful one," carries a symbolic meaning of God's grace and favor bestowed upon a beloved, encouraging strength and beauty in the face of life's challenges.
